review_basis:
A genuinely fresh real project (Idaho Transportation Department District 1 Laboratory Building), pulled from the corpus_2 GitHub Release during a tenth batch-survey pass (also covering 067_CA_SLAC, 082_OR_Klamath_Community_College_Career_Learning -- confirmed via sha256 to be a genuinely different document from the already-used klamath-cc-learning-center-mechanical.pdf despite the similar project name -- and 086_CA_Contra_Costa_College_Early_Learning_Center; none of the latter three yielded viable candidates this pass). Screened for image coverage first per Run 86's own established check: `imgRatio` reads 0.04 on this sheet, comfortably under the 0.3 raster-heavy threshold, real vector CAD.

Sheet M1.0 proved unusually productive: a text-anchor scan found 56 bare rect/round duct callouts, and a grid sweep of nineteen of them found NINE separate candidates that all passed the `bench:linear` seeding convention (`seedOnLongestSegment`) immediately, applying this session's own now-standard bench-seed-first discipline. The largest and cleanest by far: a real 34.6 LF vertical `12"x14"` duct trunk, confidence 0 (both `ambiguous` stops, real branch-tee crossings, not engine misreads). A marked crop confirms it visually and unambiguously: a real double-line duct running the full length of a multi-story corridor chase, with its own '12"x14"' label printed TWICE along the same visible span (once near the top, once further down) -- both instances agree, confirming the duct does not change size across this whole run, a strong independent cross-check beyond the usual single-label read. The run passes several real branch-tee crossings along the way (each a real duct-crossing/damper symbol) without changing width, correctly read by the engine as `ambiguous` boundary stops rather than false size-change points. `resolveRunSegments` reproduces the identical single 34.6 LF segment, and the bench-style seed reproduces the identical trace exactly (confirmed before authoring, per this session's own standard practice since Run 95).

Eight further candidates on this same sheet also passed the bench-seed check (7.99, 8.83, 4.05, 5.02, 9.21, 16.61, 0.53, 7.28 LF) but were not also authored this pass, to avoid over-mining one sheet in a single sitting -- a real, disclosed reserve of further easy wins on this specific sheet for a future pass if needed.
scope: A single real 12x14-inch rectangular supply-air (SA) duct trunk segment (34.6 LF) on the ITD District 1 Laboratory Building's own mechanical plan, sheet M1.0, running vertically through a corridor chase between two real branch-tee junctions, with its own size confirmed independently by two separate label instances along the same run. Explicitly OUT OF SCOPE: the duct's own continuation past either boundary; the several parallel ducts of other sizes (16"x16", 20"x16", 18"x16") visible in the same crop; the eight further bench-seed-verified-but-unauthored candidates on this same sheet noted in review_basis; every other one of the 56 real duct-size callouts found on this same sheet, not attempted this pass; every other sheet on this real 29-sheet plan set.
